test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.**

The group leader told Sara that she had been talking nonstop for over three minutes.

options.text: The group leader told Sara, “She had been talking nonstop for over three minutes.”
The group leader said to Sara, “You have been talking nonstop for over three minutes."
The leader said to Sara, “You are talking nonstop for over three minutes."
The group leader asked Sara, “You had been talking for three minutes nonstop.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **The group leader said to Sara, “You have been talking nonstop for over three minutes."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech **and we need to convert it to** direct speech.**
 
• When we change an **indirect speech **to **direct speech**, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb '**told**' changes to **'said to'**
 
• The conjunction '**that**' is replaced with **inverted commas ("...") **to show the direct speech.
 
• A **comma (,)** is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The **first **word of the direct speech is in **capital **letters.
 
• ** "had been"** is in the **Past Perfect Continuous form in the indirect speech**. This changes to** Present Perfect Continuous tense "have been" in the direct speech.**
 
• The pronoun '**she**' changes to '**you**'.
 
 

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

**Hence, direct speech is:** *The group leader said to Sara, “You have been talking nonstop for over three minutes."*
